scope: Raw captures of the diagnostic runs diag_v31_clock01-04 and diag_v32_* (telemetry, sensor, clock, applied-channel and backend-state streams, clouds, video states, factory arrays, per-substep and GC arrays, container-side binary records) and the replay benchmark's per-run clouds and rows.
regeneration: Not regenerable byte for byte: live runs depend on host timing. The benchmark outputs are regenerable with run_bench.py (deterministic physics; timings differ). Preserve at the exact project paths.
entry_rule: For each diagnostic run: v31's thirteen raw-capture kinds (applied_channel.jsonl, applied_sent.jsonl, artifacts/, backend_body_callbacks.jsonl, backend_states.jsonl, clock_samples.jsonl, clouds/, factory_full_rate.npz, inputs/, linux_external_episode.tar, sensor.jsonl, telemetry.jsonl, video_states.json) where present, the per-substep and GC arrays (diagnostics/substeps.npy, diagnostics/gc_events.npy) and the container-side binary records (diagnostics/linux/), plus any other file of at least 10 MB (diag_v31_clock02's backend.log and applied_read_errors.jsonl; diag_v31_clock03's and diag_v31_clock04's scan.log and sensor_manifest.json). For each benchmark run: clouds/, steps.jsonl, writer_sink.jsonl and factory_full_rate.npz. The trial v32_historical_full01 follows v31's convention instead (scan.log and sensor_manifest.json tracked); see versions/v32/LOCAL_ONLY_BYTES.json.
